statements.text: Constitutive cosmopsychism is the view that all facts, including the facts about the ordinary consciousness of humans and other animals, are grounded in consciousness-involving facts concerning the universe. Its minimal commitment is that the universe is conscious. It is the top-down form of constitutive panpsychism, beside bottom-up micropsychism.
